app.title: Memory Card
app.unidentified: Home Assistant did not say who you are, so Memory Card cannot open. Reload the page from the sidebar.
app.managersOnly: Only managers can use this page.
app.noManagers: Memory Card is read-only until you name a manager in Home Assistant, under Settings > Apps > Memory Card > Configuration.
app.openSettings: Find your user ID in Settings

placeholder.notBuilt: This screen is not built yet.

manage.intro: Organize the devices, stores, platforms, and play statuses used in your collection.

devices.empty: No devices yet. Add the consoles, handhelds, PCs and store accounts your games live on.
devices.nameDescription: How you pick this device for a copy. Use names that tell your devices apart.
devices.modelDescription: Optional. The hardware model or edition, shown under the name on this screen.
devices.platformsDescription: Platforms whose games this device runs. A Wii U plays Wii U and Wii.
devices.activeDescription: Inactive devices are left out when choosing where a copy lives.
devices.deleteCopies_one: {{count}} copy is on this device. It will be kept with no device.
devices.deleteCopies_other: {{count}} copies are on this device. They will be kept with no device.

stores.empty: No stores yet. Add the shops and online stores you buy games from.
stores.deleteCopies_one: {{count}} copy was bought here. It will be kept with no store.
stores.deleteCopies_other: {{count}} copies were bought here. They will be kept with no store.

platforms.inUse: Games or devices use this platform. Deactivate it instead.
platforms.yourText: Shown when adding games and devices, in this order. Drag to reorder.
platforms.yourEmpty: No platforms yet. Add the ones you own from the list below.
platforms.removeHint: Hide it when adding games and devices. Its games and devices stay.
platforms.catalogText: Add the platforms you own so they show up when adding games and devices.

drag.instructions: To move a platform, press space or enter, use the arrow keys, then press space or enter again. Press escape to cancel.

settings.intro: Choose your theme and check the integrations used by your collection.
settings.igdbMissing: Not configured. Add your Twitch client ID and secret in the app configuration to fetch covers and metadata.
settings.igdbOffline: Off. External services are turned off in the app configuration, so Memory Card does not contact IGDB.
settings.appearanceDescription: Choose a theme, or follow your system. Saved on this browser.
settings.accessNoManagers: Nobody can change the collection until a manager is named. Copy your user ID below. In Home Assistant, go to Settings > Apps > Memory Card > Configuration, add the ID to Managers, save, then restart the app.
settings.accessViewer: You can browse the collection. Ask a manager to make changes.
settings.accessViewerProgress: You can browse the collection and track play progress. Ask a manager to make other changes.

errors.name_taken: This name is already in use.

errors.invalid_copy: Pick a copy of this game.

errors.release_exists: Another release of this game has the same platform, region and product code.

errors.igdb_not_found: IGDB has no game with this id.
errors.platform_builtin: Platforms that come with the app cannot be deleted. Remove it from your platforms instead.

errors.unknown_play_status: That play status no longer exists. Reload the page.

errors.identity_required: Home Assistant did not say who you are. Reload the page.

import.intro: Move your collection between Memory Card and a spreadsheet.
import.exportText: Download every copy as a CSV file. Edit it in a spreadsheet and import it again to update your collection.
import.importText: One row per copy. A row with only game columns adds a game with no copies. Nothing changes until you confirm.
import.nothingToDo: Nothing in this file changes your collection.
import.hasErrors: Fix the rows below in your spreadsheet, then choose the file again.
import.done: Imported {{games}} new games and {{copies}} new copies, updated {{updated}} copies.
import.unlinked_one: {{count}} game is not linked to IGDB yet. Sync with IGDB links games whose title matches and fills in their details.
import.unlinked_other: {{count}} games are not linked to IGDB yet. Sync with IGDB links games whose title matches and fills in their details.
import.openSync: Go to Sync with IGDB in Settings
import.columnsText: Column names are not case sensitive and can be in any order. Only game_title is required in every row. Files saved with ; as separator work too.

columns.copy_id: Filled in by the export. Keep it to update that copy; leave it empty to add a new one.
columns.igdb_id: Optional IGDB game id. Tells apart games with the same title.
columns.play_status: backlog, playing, paused, completed, dropped, mastered.
columns.platform: Platform name, abbreviation or slug, as on the Manage screen. Unknown names are created.
columns.region: na, eu, au, nz, jp, cn, asia, kr, br, ww (worldwide or region-free). Also NTSC-U, PAL, NTSC-J.
columns.release_title: Title on this release, when it differs from the game title.
columns.product_code: Serial or product code printed on the box.
columns.device: Device name, as on the Manage screen. Unknown names are created.
columns.store: Store name. Unknown names are created.
columns.condition: Physical copies only: sealed, cib, no_manual, loose.

importIssues.invalid_number: Must be a positive whole number.
importIssues.unknown_copy: No copy has this ID. Leave copy_id empty to add a new copy.
importIssues.duplicate_copy_id: Another row uses the same copy_id.
importIssues.wanted_unsupported: Wanted copies are not supported yet.
importIssues.ambiguous_game: More than one game has this title. Add the igdb_id.
importIssues.ambiguous_platform: More than one platform uses this abbreviation. Use the full name.
importIssues.conflicting_play_status: Another row gives this game a different play status.
importIssues.device_platform_mismatch: This device is not set to play this platform.

fileIssues.not_utf8: The file is not UTF-8. Save it as "CSV UTF-8" and try again.
fileIssues.malformed: The file could not be read as CSV near line {{line}}.
fileIssues.too_many_rows: The file has more than 20,000 rows.

playStatuses.intro: Shown in this order wherever you pick a status. Drag to reorder. The six built-in statuses can be renamed but not deleted, so integrations can rely on them.
playStatuses.name: Name
playStatuses.countsAsHint: Decides where its games show on the Backlog page and whether "Pick for me" can choose them.
playStatuses.moveTo_one: {{count}} game has this status. Move it to:
playStatuses.moveTo_other: {{count}} games have this status. Move them to:

drag.instructions: To move a status, press space or enter, use the arrow keys, then press space or enter again. Press escape to cancel.

library.empty: No games yet. Import a CSV file or add a game.

filter.minLocalPlayers: Players on the same screen, at least

library.description: All your games, in one place.

game.title: Title
game.deleteMessage_one: Its {{count}} copy will be deleted too.
game.deleteMessage_other: Its {{count}} copies will be deleted too.
game.releasesDescription: Edit a release or manage the copies in your collection.
game.addCopyHere: Add a copy of this release
game.deleteReleaseCopies_one: Its {{count}} copy will be deleted too.
game.deleteReleaseCopies_other: Its {{count}} copies will be deleted too.
game.releasePlayersHint: Leave empty to use the game's player counts.
game.showAllDevices: Show devices that do not list this platform

igdb.syncText: Links each game whose title matches exactly one IGDB game, then updates details and covers of every linked game. Link the games it cannot match from their page.
igdb.syncResult: Last sync: {{linked}} linked, {{updated}} updated, {{unmatched}} not matched, {{failed}} failed.
igdb.overwrite: Replace the title, summary, game modes, player counts and release titles and dates with IGDB's
igdb.titlesText_one: {{count}} linked game has a different title on IGDB. Use IGDB's title or keep yours. A kept title comes back here only if IGDB renames the game.
igdb.titlesText_other: {{count}} linked games have a different title on IGDB. Use IGDB's title or keep yours. A kept title comes back here only if IGDB renames the game.
igdb.titlesNone: No game titles need review. Sync with IGDB to check for changes.

backlog.title: Backlog
backlog.intro: Games waiting for you. Pick one and clear the list.
backlog.unsortedText_one: {{count}} game has no play status, so it is not in the backlog yet.
backlog.unsortedText_other: {{count}} games have no play status, so they are not in the backlog yet.
backlog.pickText: Roll a random game from your backlog. Games picked in the last day are skipped.

duplicates.intro: Games you own more than one copy of.
duplicates.empty: No duplicates. You own one copy of every game.

setup.intro: Go through games that lack details, one at a time. Fill in what you know or skip to the next game.
setup.complete: Nothing left to fill in for this game.
setup.coverHint: Select the cover to upload one.
setup.copiesHint: This game has no copies yet.
setup.done: You went through every game on the list.
